title: Circular density estimation
text: Linear kernel density estimates treat endpoints far apart. Circular kernels wrap around boundary.

title: Circular density estimation
text: stat_circular_density() uses von Mises kernel, exp(kappa * cos(theta - mu)) / (2 * pi * I0(kappa)), I0 modified Bessel function order zero.
code: library(ggplot2) library(ggcircular)  ggplot(wind_directions, aes(x = direction)) +   geom_circular_density(linewidth = 1) +   scale_x_circular_degrees() +   coord_circular() +   theme_circular()
